title: Altıntepe, 425 miles away, shares the same symbols
summary: Matt tells of Altıntepe, 425 miles away, shares the same symbols, about ancient at Altıntepe, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a site called Alton Tepe mhm you ready for this 425 miles away from the other sites

plain: A researcher named Matt, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, talks about an ancient site in Turkey called Altıntepe. He says it lies 425 miles from a group of other ancient sites yet carries the same symbols, which to him suggests a shared culture spread far wider than people assume.
